title: BRICKSTORM_Backdoor_Investigation_ea6
description: Investigate and contain the BRICKSTORM backdoor threat on the target host.

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: The target host has exhibited unusual network activity, including connections to unknown external servers. Initial analysis suggests the presence of a sophisticated backdoor named BRICKSTORM. Your task is to investigate and contain this threat.

levels.title: Get Access
levels.cloud_content:
You have SSH access to the target host with the following credentials:
- Username: cyrano
- Password: cyrano

Enter 'start' to begin the investigation.

levels.title: Investigate Suspicious Network Connections
levels.content:
Investigate the unusual network connections on the target host.

Question: What port is being used for the suspicious outbound connections?
levels.solution: Use network monitoring tools to identify the port used for suspicious outbound connections. The port being used is 443.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Check the network connections and look for unusual destinations or ports.

levels.title: Identify Malicious Process
levels.content:
Identify the process responsible for the suspicious network activity.

Question: What is the name of the process making the suspicious connections?
levels.solution: Use process enumeration tools to find the process and its associated files. The process name is updatemgr.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Use process enumeration tools to find the process and its associated files.

levels.title: Determine Persistence Mechanism
levels.content:
Determine how the malicious process maintains persistence on the system.

Question: What is the name of the service or mechanism ensuring the malicious process runs after reboot?
levels.solution: Investigate system startup configurations and look for unusual entries. The service name is updatemgr.service.
